title: kg_sync.PLAIN_ROOT_NAME copies kbsettings' plain-name pattern, so a name layered accepts but the copy skips drops that root's gate_checks silently
goal: group_gate decides a kb directory name is plain by the one pattern kbsettings.layered uses, held in a single public name

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kg_sync
sys.exit(1 if hasattr(kg_sync,"PLAIN_ROOT_NAME") else 0)

repro_reason: a duplicated pattern drifts only when one copy changes; the check reads that the copy exists
